judge.rationale: The candidate halted after writing the test and updating the spec, completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Because `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` remains untouched, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately (`onError` is never called for non-Error rejections). The candidate also placed the test in a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and left a `.lore/dod.md` artifact, whereas the reference added the test directly into `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Only the spec update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the structure of the test assertions align with the requirements.
